boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Holy Family University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food and convenience stops around Northeast Philadelphia with late availability verified through current official location pages.

cards.title: The Frankford Avenue 7-Eleven
cards.subtitle: A 24/7 convenience stop near Holy Family University
cards.notes: Use this nearby Frankford Avenue stop when a late errand calls for hot food, packaged snacks, or other convenience-store basics.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock option on the campus-side stretch of Frankford Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The official 7-Eleven location page identifies the store at 9001 Frankford Avenue, Philadelphia, and lists it as open 24/7 with hot foods.
cards.access_notes: The official location page currently lists the store as open 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

cards.title: Coffee After Midnight on Blue Grass Road
cards.subtitle: A 24-hour drive-through northeast of campus
cards.notes: Head here when the group wants coffee, baked goods, or breakfast food without having to plan around a nightly closing time.
cards.short_summary: A continuously open coffee-and-breakfast counter with drive-through service.
cards.evidence_claim: Dunkin's official page identifies the 9490 Blue Grass Road location and lists it as open 24 hours every day with a drive-through.
cards.source_title: Dunkin' at 9490 Blue Grass Rd in Philadelphia
cards.access_notes: The official page currently lists 24-hour operation Monday through Sunday and identifies a drive-through.

cards.title: A Midnight Academy Plaza Run
cards.subtitle: Burgers and counter-service food until midnight
cards.notes: Choose this Academy Plaza counter for a late meal, checking the official page before leaving in case holiday service differs.
cards.short_summary: A straightforward midnight food option in the Red Lion Road shopping area.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's official Academy Plaza page identifies the restaurant at 3200 Red Lion Road and lists restaurant and drive-through hours through midnight daily.
cards.source_title: Wendy's Academy Plaza in Philadelphia, PA
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-through hours are currently listed as 10:00 AM–12:00 AM every day.

cards.title: The Lower Frankford Avenue Backup
cards.subtitle: A second 24/7 route along Frankford Avenue
cards.notes: Keep this address as a southbound alternative for hot food and convenience items when the closer Frankford Avenue stop is not practical.
cards.short_summary: Another all-night convenience counter on the same major Northeast corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The official 7-Eleven page identifies the store at 7901 Frankford Avenue, Philadelphia, and lists it as open 24/7 with hot foods.
cards.access_notes: The official location page currently states that this store is open 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

cards.title: The Cottman Avenue Coffee Run
cards.subtitle: Twenty-four-hour service with a drive-through
cards.notes: Use the drive-through for coffee or breakfast food on a Cottman Avenue loop; confirm item availability in the app before traveling.
cards.short_summary: An all-night Dunkin' serving the Cottman Avenue shopping corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Dunkin's official location page identifies the shop at 2327 Cottman Avenue and lists 24-hour operation every day plus a drive-through.
cards.source_title: Dunkin' at 2327 Cottman Ave in Philadelphia
cards.access_notes: The official page currently lists the shop as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday, with drive-through service.

cards.title: A Sit-Down Roosevelt Boulevard Run
cards.subtitle: A 24-hour dining room for a longer late meal
cards.notes: Pick this option when the outing calls for table service rather than a quick counter stop, and verify seating status before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A continuously open sit-down alternative to drive-through and convenience stops.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP's official location page identifies the restaurant at 4310 Roosevelt Boulevard and lists it as open 24 hours every day with dine-in and takeout.
cards.source_title: Philadelphia Late Night Food — IHOP at 4310 Roosevelt Blvd
cards.access_notes: The official late-night page currently lists the restaurant as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: The Woodhaven Boulevard Drive-Through
cards.subtitle: A 24-hour option toward the Franklin Mills area
cards.notes: Save this for a northeast-bound coffee or breakfast-food run; use the drive-through and check current ordering availability first.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock Dunkin' positioned along the Woodhaven Boulevard route.
cards.evidence_claim: Dunkin's official Philadelphia directory lists 4046 Woodhaven Boulevard as open 24 hours, while its direct location page confirms the address and drive-through.
cards.source_title: Dunkin' at 4046 Woodhaven Blvd in Philadelphia
cards.access_notes: Dunkin's current official Philadelphia directory lists this location as open 24 hours; the direct page identifies a drive-through.

cards.title: The Welsh Road All-Nighter
cards.subtitle: A 24/7 convenience stop west of the campus corridor
cards.notes: Use this Welsh Road address as a late-running alternative for hot food and packaged provisions when traveling west from campus.
cards.short_summary: A continuously open convenience option serving the Welsh Road side of Northeast Philadelphia.
cards.evidence_claim: The official 7-Eleven location page identifies the store at 1900–10 Welsh Road and lists it as open 24/7 with hot foods.
cards.access_notes: The official location page currently lists this Welsh Road store as open 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

cards.title: The Bustleton Avenue Night Run
cards.subtitle: Late service on most nights with a drive-through
cards.notes: Check the day-specific schedule before leaving: this location runs overnight most days but has shorter Sunday and Monday service.
cards.short_summary: A late Bustleton Avenue stop whose access changes at the edges of the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Dunkin's official page identifies 11725 Bustleton Avenue and lists continuous operation Tuesday through Saturday, midnight Monday closing, and 10:00 PM Sunday closing.
cards.source_title: Dunkin' at 11725 Bustleton Ave in Philadelphia
cards.access_notes: Currently open 24 hours Tuesday–Saturday; Monday closes at midnight and Sunday closes at 10:00 PM. A drive-through is listed.

cards.title: The Torresdale Avenue Weekend Run
cards.subtitle: Late restaurant and drive-through hours Thursday through Saturday
cards.notes: Reserve this run for Thursday through Saturday, when the official schedule extends past midnight; other nights end at 11:00 PM.
cards.short_summary: A day-dependent option whose useful late window falls at the end of the week.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's official page identifies the restaurant at 1801 Torresdale Avenue and lists restaurant and drive-through service until 3:30 AM Thursday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: McDonald's at 1801 Torresdale Ave, Philadelphia, PA
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-through currently close at 3:30 AM Thursday–Saturday and 11:00 PM Sunday–Wednesday.

warnings: Hours can change for holidays or temporary operating conditions; consult each direct location page before departure.
Several destinations require a vehicle or a longer trip from campus; no claim of walkability is made.
